# Eye Rest

> A calm, hand-painted macOS menu-bar app that enforces the 20-20-20 eye-rest rule with full-screen painterly break scenes. Free to start; Pro is a one-time $14.99 (no subscription), macOS 14+.

Eye Rest reminds knowledge workers to rest their eyes on the 20-20-20 rule and turns each break into a hand-painted scene they'll actually take. A gentle heads-up precedes every break, and any break can be skipped or snoozed, so it never ambushes you. Differentiator: beauty drives adherence — unlike utilitarian break apps (LookAway, Time Out, Stretchly) that get uninstalled.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://hungranger.github.io/eyerest/): overview, the six scenes, pricing, FAQ
- [Pricing](https://hungranger.github.io/eyerest/pricing.md): free tier + $14.99 one-time Pro, 14-day trial, up to 3 Macs
- [Support](https://hungranger.github.io/eyerest/support.html)
- [Privacy](https://hungranger.github.io/eyerest/privacy.html)
- [Download (always latest release)](https://github.com/hungranger/eyerest/releases/latest/download/EyeRest.dmg)

## Positioning
- Beauty drives adherence: the break is a hand-painted scene you look forward to, not a pop-up you dismiss — so you actually take it.
- Audience: Mac knowledge workers (developers, designers, writers, analysts) with digital eye strain who have uninstalled naggy break apps before.
- vs alternatives: differs from LookAway, Time Out, and Stretchly on the hand-painted full-screen break scene and a flat one-time $14.99 (no per-device tiers, no subscription).
- Free tier includes the pre-break heads-up and skip/snooze; Pro adds smart auto-pause (video calls, browser video, idle), all six scenes, office hours, and stats.
